tables.title: TABLE I - BLADE DATA
tables.notes: Headings split into heading row and unit row (units were printed in parentheses inside the headings). 'Axial projection of chord at hub radius' has no printed unit (inches by context). Second read cell by cell from a zoomed crop done.

tables.title: TABLE II - VELOCITY DIAGRAM DATA (a) For rotor rows
tables.notes: Column groups printed: Entrance vector data (Z, X, Y, h, W/Ut, W/a, β'), Change through row (Δh, Δβ), Blade data (α, CLσ, σ). Station number printed only on the first of five rows; repeated here on every row. No unit row printed (angles in deg per symbol list). Second read from 1.8x zoomed crops done; additionally checked numerically: W/Ut = sqrt((Z-X)^2+h^2), tan β' = (Z-X)/h, Δβ = β' - atan((Z-X-Y)/(h+Δh)), σ = N c /(2π r) with Table I. Two printed cells disagree with the check (see notes.md); both re-zoomed and kept as printed.

tables.title: TABLE II - VELOCITY DIAGRAM DATA - Concluded (b) For stator rows
tables.notes: Same layout as (a) with V/Ut, V/a, β. Second read from zoomed crops done; numerical check V/Ut = sqrt((X+Y)^2+h^2), tan β = (X+Y)/h, Δβ = β - atan(X/(h+Δh)), σ = N c/(2π r): all rows consistent. Station 16 row Z=.9693: X printed '..2676' (stray dot), transcribed .2676.
